evals.prompt: Create an enterprise PowerShell advanced function in a module to install enterprise certificates with parameter validation attributes.
evals.expected_output: An advanced function decorated with [CmdletBinding()], typed parameters with [ValidateNotNullOrEmpty()], parameter splatting, and Export-ModuleMember.
assertions: Parameters are explicitly typed in param(...) block
Employs hashtable parameter splatting (@params) instead of Invoke-Expression
Passes PSScriptAnalyzer checks without hardcoded credentials

evals.prompt: Write a Pester 5 unit test suite for a PowerShell certificate installation module without modifying host stores.
evals.expected_output: A Pester 5 test file with Describe/Context/It blocks, mock configurations, and isolated cleanup in BeforeAll/AfterAll.
assertions: Adheres to Pester 5 syntax with Describe and It blocks
Tests are non-mutating on host system using isolated temporary paths
Includes cleanup in AfterAll block to prevent side effects
